digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow gate dispatch and plan-review container staging
propositions: Three defensive exception-handling arms in gate_dispatch and container_stage lack test coverage despite mutation-proof reachability in production batch-step paths.

Plan-review mid-run arm in produce_plan_review_verdict and _run_code_review_gate must handle both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError, degrading to INDETERMINATE verdict with gate_error sidecar instead of propagating or aborting.

Container warm-call abort in _run_container must abort the fan-out (raise immediately, single model invocation) when either LLMUnavailableError or LLMInputRejectedError occurs, not degrade to direct fan-out.

Code-review mid-run arm is a defensive seam contract at the run_workflow boundary because systemic errors are absorbed upstream by CodeReviewBatchRunner and discovery.execute_stage, with no in-tree raw raiser proven.
